title: Lifecycle document front-matter
//: The machine-readable half of a human-written document. The prose stays prose - that is the whole point. This block only declares what the document IS and what it descends from, which is the minimum a traceability graph needs and the maximum that can be kept honest by hand.

defines.description: ID prefixes this document owns. A definition found elsewhere is a finding.

traces.description: Upstream documents this one was derived from. Repo-relative paths.

owner.description: The phase-owner subagent responsible for it.
